direct_gripper_push.description: Keep the cube on the table and push it using the closed gripper.

skills.canonical_template: Close the gripper and push the cube at <point_1> to the target at <point_2>
skills.completion_condition: The cube is visibly on the target while remaining tabletop-supported.

peg_push.description: Pick up the peg, then use it to hook/push the cube to the target.

skills.completion_condition: The peg is securely held by the gripper.

skills.canonical_template: Hook the cube at <point_1> to the target at <point_2> with the peg
skills.completion_condition: The cube is visibly on the target after being moved with the held peg.

grasp_putdown.description: Pick up the cube and place it onto the target.

skills.completion_condition: The cube is securely grasped and lifted from the table.

skills.canonical_template: Place the cube onto the target at <point_1>
skills.completion_condition: The cube is visibly supported by the target.
